subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should OpenClaw make TUI-local shell results durable session content, with `!` entering the agent’s next context and `!!` remaining history-only, through a new hidden operator-admin Gateway method?
rationale: The branch is implementing a new persisted transcript and model-context contract rather than repairing defined existing behavior; code review cannot decide whether these semantics and the additional Gateway API should become supported product behavior.

options.title: Sponsor and harden
options.body: Approve the proposed opt-in semantics, then require retry idempotency, fresh-session support, a current-main refresh, and exact-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep persistence local/history-only or choose different syntax and API ownership before the contributor continues implementation.

options.title: Decline durable shell output
options.body: Keep local shell commands ephemeral and close the PR if maintainers do not want this transcript and model-context surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and harden
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed opt-in semantics, then require retry idempotency, fresh-session support, a current-main refresh, and exact-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The explicit mention and subscription on this PR provide the clearest available signal for routing the TUI/Gateway product decision.
